People: George Cavendish (author, Wikidata Q1226237), died 1562; George Wyatt (other, Wikidata Q5546554), died 1624; Samuel Weller Singer (editor, Wikidata Q7412903), died 1858. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Cavendish, George, 1500-1561?; Wyatt, George, 1554-1624 [Contributor]; Singer, Samuel Weller, 1783-1858 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The life of Cardinal Wolsey from the original autograph Manuscript, London, 1827, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/lifecardinalwol00singgoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 77%, 74%, 83% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of George Wyatt, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
